review_mode: Independent read-only source and transitive-definition review; no builds or source edits
findings: step_gas_nonincrease extracts actual Z acceptance and StepOk from XStepAt and applies ReturnedGas.step_remaining at exactly the step fuel. XStepAt fuel denotes an X iteration at fuel+1; no off-by-one substitution is introduced.

ReturnedGas.StepBound compares post gas to original pre-Z gas, including the charge and recursive returned gas. Its mutual strong-fuel induction covers actual completed call/creation outcomes, including failures; this module adds no child-success, no-wrap or no-OutOfFuel premise.
runs_gas_nonincrease follows XRuns.cons and composes inequalities in the correct post<=mid<=pre order. Trace labels and fuel remain those of actual accepted nonhalting iterations.
Reaches is forall f, exists actual XRuns from f+1+k to f+1 at the same endpoints. Instantiating f=0 is sufficient for endpoint gas nonincrease and does not assert fuel-independent recursive outcomes.

atCreate_gas_le applies to the supplied Reaches witness, including a witness retained by FactoryChildResources.entry_resources. Its endpoint gas is definitionally the explicit gas argument, and entry gas is a.gas.

prefix_bounds obtains gas/e/lowerBound/Reaches once from reaches_create2 and derives the upper bound on exactly that same witness. It does not combine unrelated existential prefixes or stipulate a predicted post-state gas bound.
assumptions_and_limits: prefix_bounds retains exact factory runtime bytes, exact initializer calldata and entry gas>=200. It proves a 13-instruction actual prefix to CREATE2, not child execution or successful deployment.

The generic upper bound is nonincrease, not strict decrease or equality with nominal opcode costs. The lower estimate a.gas-157 uses natural truncated subtraction; the explicit gas>=200 makes its factory use meaningful.
No canonical factory deployment, address hash binding, reference execution/resource transport, protocol history extraction, or whole-call success is established. No reference gas equality is claimed.
